1. (Currently amended) An air braking unit for use in an air braking system, the air braking unit being arranged to be positioned, in use, at a vehicle wheel, and comprising: an inlet for receiving, in use, compressed air from a central source; at least one first valve arranged to selectively allow for a controlled amount of compressed air from the inlet to enter a wheel brake chamber in use; at least one second valve arranged to selectively allow air from the brake chamber to be released via an outlet to the atmosphere in use; and control means for controlling the first and second valves to operate to selectively control the varying air pressure in the brake chamber in use.

5. (Currently amended) The air braking unit of any preceding claim, wherein one or more of the valves are driven by binary actuators or proportional solenoid actuators. 

6. (Currently amended) An air braking unit according to any preceding claim, wherein the control means is arranged to receive control signals from a wheel speed sensor, an air pressure sensor for determining the pressure in the brake chamber, and further including a reference data source indicative of an optimum braking force for given vehicle and wheel speeds. 

7. (Currently amended) An air braking unit according to claim 6, wherein the control means is arranged to receive data from a vehicle speed sensor, and reference data indicative of an optimum braking force for each wheel based on varying vehicle and wheel speeds and control braking force based thereon.

8. (Currently amended) An air braking unit according to claim 6 or claim 7, wherein the control means is arranged to determine, from the sensors and stored reference data, an optimum speed for each wheel and to control the braking force on each wheel in accordance with the calculated optimum speed.
